text:
sam: Heads up — we need GPU quota increases in ap-southeast-2 for two new AWS accounts (partner pilot). Specifically asking for p5, p4d and g5 families. Can someone take point on filing the requests?

leah: Which account IDs and how many of each instance type? Also do we need ENI / vCPU bumps? :thinking_face:

sam: Account IDs: 123456789012 (redwood-apac-prod) and 210987654321 (redwood-apac-dev). Target quotas: p5.48xlarge -> 8 per account, p4d.24xlarge -> 4 per account, g5.12xlarge -> 16 per account. Rough justification: Dedicated pool for pilot customers + CI/canary runs. We'll also need ENI increase + vCPU on the prod account if approved.

chris: Got it. Reminder — AWS often wants an explicit justification with expected sustained vGPU hours and whether this is for production. Include target launch date and AZ spread. Also include expected monthly spend so they understand long-lived demand.

leah: I'll file the Support Center/Service Quotas requests. Plan: open Support case + Service Quotas requests for each instance family. I’ll include this template in the case body: 

```
Account IDs: 123456789012, 210987654321
Region: ap-southeast-2
Instance families & requested counts: p5 (8), p4d (4), g5 (16) per account
Use case: Dedicated inference + canary jobs for partner pilot, latency-sensitive production traffic (describe fallback models)
Launch target: 2026-04-15
Monthly estimated vGPU hours: 60,000
Contact: leah@redwood.com; infra oncall
Additional requests: EC2 ENI and vCPU quota increases to match instance counts.
```

chris: Nicely formatted. Also add that we can provide a PO/contract and that some instances are burstable for short-term testing. That speeds approvals.

ops-bot: Ticket created: SR-2026-000874 — Support case opened for GPU quota increases. Service Quotas requests submitted for p5/p4d/g5 in ap-southeast-2 for accounts 123456789012 and 210987654321. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=SR-2026-000874

sam: thanks ops-bot. Can you also add ENI request items? For g5 we need high ENI count — estimate +200 ENIs on prod.

leah: Adding ENI + vCPU numbers to the case now. Also created entries in the internal tracker: https://redwood.internal/infra/quota-tracker (spreadsheet) — I'll paste the row after case is updated.

chris: FYI — if AWS asks about AZ placement, say we want even spread across 3 AZs and list expected per-AZ instance counts. If they push, mention Dedicated pool commitments coming in Q2.

sam: Ownership: leah files & monitors until SR resolves, chris to help if AWS requests technical details, sam to coordinate with sales for contract evidence. Post updates here. :thumbsup:

leah: Marking as in-progress. Will post Service Quotas IDs and any follow-ups here. ETA for first response: ~24h (support "low" -> normal SLA).

sam: One more — we may also request increased EBS gp3 throughput/IOPS if they say it's needed for model pulls. Add a note in the case.

ops-bot: Update: Service Quotas request IDs: SQ-APAC-000912 (p5), SQ-APAC-000913 (p4d), SQ-APAC-000914 (g5). Support case SR-2026-000874 in progress.

leah: Posted the tracker row and estimated monthly cost: ~$68k if fully utilized (pre-negotiation). Will keep everyone posted.

chris: Thanks — once approvals land, we should create temporary autoscaling limits in the Dedicated pool config so onboarding doesn't oversubscribe.

sam: Perfect. Closing loop once SR resolved.
